title: Sequential framework for predicting postoperative recurrence and antiseizure-medication withdrawal risk in mesial temporal lobe epilepsy

abstract: Mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (mTLE) is a common drug-resistant epilepsy. Temporal lobe resection is the most effective treatment, but postoperative recurrence and antiseizure medication (ASM) withdrawal remain major clinical challenges. Existing prediction tools are limited by endpoint specificity, restricted external validation, and lack of integration into sequential postoperative management pathways. We developed a sequential modelling strategy in mTLE, spanning recurrence prediction to ASM withdrawal risk stratification. In phase 1, postoperative recurrence models were developed and validated using 52 preoperative multimodal features in 1278 patients across cohorts 1–4 (three retrospective, one prospective). Five top-ranked models achieved AUCs of 0.926–0.932 (internal) and 0.830–0.931 (three external sets), with a three-tier (low/intermediate/high) risk stratification. In phase 2, ASM withdrawal recurrence models were developed and validated in 679 seizure-free, phase 1 low/intermediate-risk patients eligible for withdrawal across cohorts 5–8 (three retrospective, one prospective). Five top-ranked models achieved AUCs of 0.897–0.902 (internal) and 0.789–0.933 (three external sets), with risk stratification for individualized withdrawal estimation. Models showed good calibration, net clinical benefit, and SHAP-based interpretability. A research-based risk-estimation web tool was developed to support potential clinical translation. This promising modelling strategy integrates population-level risk stratification with individualized prediction, providing preliminary postoperative guidance: high-recurrence-risk patients may not be ideal for early ASM withdrawal despite seizure freedom, while low-risk patients may be considered for earlier withdrawal evaluation. Given the primarily retrospective design and relatively small phase 2 prospective cohort, further prospective external validation and clinical-impact studies are required before routine implementation.
zh_abstract: 内侧颞叶癫痫（mTLE）是一种常见的药物难治性癫痫。颞叶切除术是最有效的治疗方法，但术后复发和抗癫痫药物（ASM）停药仍是主要的临床挑战。现有预测工具受限于终点特异性、外部验证有限，以及缺乏与术后序贯管理路径的整合。我们在mTLE中建立了一种序贯建模策略，涵盖从复发预测到ASM停药风险分层。在第1阶段，利用队列1–4（三个回顾性队列，一个前瞻性队列）共1278例患者的52项术前多模态特征，开发并验证了术后复发模型。排名前五的模型内部验证AUC为0.926–0.932，三个外部数据集AUC为0.830–0.931，并实现了三级（低/中/高）风险分层。在第2阶段，在队列5–8（三个回顾性队列，一个前瞻性队列）中，对679例无发作且第1阶段为低/中风险、符合停药条件的患者开发并验证了ASM停药后复发模型。排名前五的模型内部验证AUC为0.897–0.902，三个外部数据集AUC为0.789–0.933，并可进行风险分层以估计个体化停药情况。模型显示出良好的校准度、净临床获益以及基于SHAP的可解释性。我们还开发了一个基于研究的风险评估网络工具，以支持潜在的临床转化。这一有前景的建模策略将人群水平的风险分层与个体化预测相结合，提供了初步的术后指导：复发风险高的患者尽管已无发作，可能不适合早期停用ASM，而低风险患者可考虑较早进行停药评估。鉴于研究主要为回顾性设计，且第2阶段前瞻性队列相对较小，在常规实施之前仍需进一步的前瞻性外部验证和临床影响研究。

title: Multimodal AI for bacterial vs viral upper respiratory tract infection multicentre development and internal validation

abstract: Distinguishing Group A streptococcus (GAS) pharyngitis from viral upper respiratory tract infections (URTIs) is critical for appropriate antibiotic use but remains difficult on symptoms alone. We developed and internally validated a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) model fusing pharyngeal images (Swin Transformer) with clinical metadata via gradient boosting decision trees, using 6666 visits and 119,988 images from 44 facilities collected March 2023–August 2025. For discriminating GAS from non-GAS (influenza A/B, COVID-19), the fusion model achieved area under the curve (AUC) 0.917 (95% confidence interval 0.907–0.926), outperforming image-only (0.902), metadata-only (0.871) and proxy Centor/McIsaac scores. At a pre-specified high-specificity threshold (≥0.90) sensitivity was 0.761; simulations indicated antibiotic-prescription reductions of 23–56% across GAS prevalences of 5–20%. External validation and prospective evaluation are needed.

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Ocular oncology sits in an unusual position for medical artificial intelligence (AI), imaging heavy and multimodal by nature, but constrained by the rarity of the tumours it treats. Uveal melanoma, the most common primary intraocular malignancy in adults, accounts for approximately 7095 new cases worldwide each year. Choroidal naevi are present in approximately 5% of the white population aged 40 and over, of which roughly 1 in 8845 transforms into melanoma each year, leaving a large benign population within which a small number of melanomas must not be missed. This narrative review follows the uveal melanoma clinical pathway through detection, diagnosis and prognosis, asking at each stage which class of AI model the evidence supports. A structured PubMed search returned 176 unique records, from which 29 primary studies were included, 17 (59%) published in 2025 or 2026. At detection, heavy self-supervised foundation models generalise well across imaging hardware but lack calibration to a clinical decision, while lightweight purpose-built classifiers show the opposite trade-off, and only one tool has been tested in a real referral workflow, quadrupling the odds of correct referral and cutting false positives 10-fold. At diagnosis, purpose-built convolutional classifiers calibrated to a referral threshold remain most mature, reaching 0.88 AUC on two cohorts, while multimodal fusion claims rest on a single 0.01 AUC gain. At prognosis, biomarker prediction from routine pathology reaches 0.93 to 0.99 AUC, survival prediction lags, only 7 of 29 studies (24%) had external validation and none of the tools has regulatory clearance.

title: A noise-corrected metric for evaluating spatial transcriptomics predicted from histology

abstract: Deep learning methods that predict spatial transcriptomics from histology offer scalable molecular profiling of clinical cohorts. However, conventional correlation metrics overstate prediction quality across whole sections by crediting models for recognizing broad tissue regions, and understate fine-scale prediction quality because sampling noise dominates sparse RNA counts. To resolve this, we introduce the reproducible-signal correlation (RSC) metric. RSC randomly splits RNA counts into two halves to separate reproducible signal from sampling noise across spatial scales and within tissue regions or cell classes. Across 12 spot-level and three single-cell methods, RSC revealed that most models capture broad tissue patterns but largely miss differences between neighboring spots or cells, which whole-section correlation overlooks. Within malignant cells, RSC distinguished methods that genuinely capture part of the cell-to-cell heterogeneity from those whose scores across all cells were inflated by cell-type composition. Guided by RSC, we designed a pairwise difference loss between neighboring spots that improved fine-scale predictions on average across 11 models. RSC thus provides a foundation for benchmarking predictions, guiding model design and determining which spatial analyses histology can support.
zh_abstract: 从组织学图像预测空间转录组的深度学习方法可为临床队列提供可扩展的分子谱分析。然而，传统的相关性指标会因模型能识别大范围组织区域而高估整张切片的预测质量，同时又因采样噪声主导稀疏的RNA计数而低估精细尺度的预测质量。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可重复信号相关性（reproducible-signal correlation，RSC）指标。RSC将RNA计数随机分为两半，以在不同空间尺度以及组织区域或细胞类别内部区分可重复信号与采样噪声。在12种基于点（spot）水平的方法和3种单细胞方法中，RSC显示大多数模型能捕捉大范围的组织模式，但在很大程度上无法捕捉相邻点或细胞之间的差异，而整张切片相关性忽略了这一点。在恶性细胞内部，RSC可区分真正捕捉到部分细胞间异质性的方法与其全部细胞得分因细胞类型构成而被夸大的方法。在RSC指导下，我们设计了相邻点之间的成对差异损失，平均而言改善了11个模型的精细尺度预测。因此，RSC为预测基准评估、指导模型设计以及确定组织学可支持哪些空间分析提供了基础。

abstract: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and applying medical requirements under their intended conditions. We introduce LingSante MedGuard, a capability-enhanced guardrail that integrates supervision from a medical guardrail teacher model and six specialized medical capability experts into a unified model. The guardrail teacher supervises risk decisions and explanations across medical safety, compliance, and ethics, while the capability experts support medical rule understanding, numerical reasoning, multimodal hallucination detection, agentic safety verification, risk localization, and multimodal entity understanding. We consolidate these sources of supervision through offline supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated demonstrations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using feedback on student-generated responses. We further introduce LingSante MedGuardBench, a benchmark comprising 11 risk-detection subsets spanning medical safety, compliance, and ethics. At 4B, 9B, and 27B scales, LingSante MedGuard achieves mean benchmark F1 scores of 82.3%, 82.4%, and 87.4%, respectively. The 4B model also achieves 73.9% mean accuracy across MedHallu and MedHALT-NOTA under retrieval-enabled evaluation. Additional evaluations of the verification components show improvements in evidence-supported consistency, source traceability, and rule-guided rationale quality across model scales. These results support the integration of specialized medical capabilities into a unified guardrail for medical risk assessment and evidence-based medical safety verification.
zh_abstract: 随着医疗人工智能越来越多地用于患者咨询和临床决策支持，识别有害、不合规或存在伦理问题的回答，对于负责任地部署至关重要。评估这些风险需要将临床论断与相关证据进行核对、验证计算，并在预期条件下应用医学要求。我们提出了 LingSante MedGuard，这是一种能力增强型护栏模型，它将来自一个医疗护栏教师模型和六个专业医学能力专家的监督整合到一个统一模型中。护栏教师负责监督医疗安全、合规和伦理方面的风险判定及解释，而能力专家则支持医学规则理解、数值推理、多模态幻觉检测、智能体（agentic）安全验证、风险定位和多模态实体理解。我们通过两步整合这些监督来源：先基于教师生成的示范进行离线监督微调，随后利用对学生模型生成回答的反馈进行多教师在线策略（on-policy）蒸馏。我们还提出了 LingSante MedGuardBench，这是一个包含11个风险检测子集的基准，涵盖医疗安全、合规和伦理。在4B、9B和27B规模下，LingSante MedGuard 的基准平均F1分数分别为82.3%、82.4%和87.4%。在启用检索的评估条件下，4B模型在 MedHallu 和 MedHALT-NOTA 上的平均准确率也达到73.9%。对验证组件的进一步评估显示，在各模型规模下，证据支持的一致性、来源可追溯性以及规则引导的推理依据质量均有所提升。这些结果支持将专业医学能力整合到统一护栏中，用于医疗风险评估和基于证据的医疗安全验证。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Social work informatics (SWI) was proposed as a professional specialty in 2006, yet social work remains under-represented in health informatics governance, research, and system design even as artificial intelligence (AI) shapes high-stakes clinical decisions. This paper introduces the SWI Equity Framework, positioning social work as a leader in designing equitable health informatics systems. The framework was developed through a synthesis of social work, health informatics, and health equity literature. The framework identifies 6 domains: reflexive system co-design, social determinants of health data integration, training-data quality and representation, contextual interpretation of AI outputs, community leadership, and equitable accountability. The framework highlights opportunities to integrate social work expertise throughout the health informatics lifecycle, moving beyond consultation toward active participation in system design, implementation, and governance. It also outlines pathways for advancing social work informatics through education, interdisciplinary research, health systems, and professional infrastructure. Social work is particularly well positioned to advance the equity agenda of health informatics and offers profession-specific expertise that can strengthen equity, accountability, and implementation across the informatics lifecycle.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 社会工作信息学（SWI）于2006年被提出作为一个专业方向，然而即使人工智能（AI）正在影响高风险的临床决策，社会工作在健康信息学的治理、研究和系统设计中的代表性仍然不足。本文提出了SWI公平框架，将社会工作定位为设计公平的健康信息学系统的引领者。该框架通过综合社会工作、健康信息学和健康公平方面的文献而形成。该框架确定了6个领域：反思性系统共同设计、健康社会决定因素数据整合、训练数据质量与代表性、对AI输出的情境化解读、社区领导，以及公平的问责。该框架强调了在整个健康信息学生命周期中整合社会工作专业知识的机会，从提供咨询转向积极参与系统的设计、实施和治理。它还概述了通过教育、跨学科研究、卫生系统和专业基础设施推进社会工作信息学的路径。社会工作特别适合推进健康信息学的公平议程，并能提供专业特有的专长，以加强整个信息学生命周期中的公平性、问责和实施。

abstract: [Journal of neural engineering] Deep learning models have been widely applied to predict major depressive disorder (MDD) using magnetoencephalography (MEG) signals. However, these models often suffer from limited performance and generalization. This is primarily due to the strong individual heterogeneity inherent in MEG temporal signals, which makes it difficult for models trained on small samples to distinguish disease-related features and individual-specific features. To address this issue, we propose GRLV, a plug-and-play framework based on gradient reversal layer with variance loss, that can be readily embedded into existing deep learning classification models. This framework introduces a variance loss function to the gradient reversal layer (GRL) framework to compensate for its convergence limitations. We evaluated GRLV on 10 backbone models, achieving an average classification accuracy of 68.2%, and surpassing baseline models by 3.5%. These findings fully demonstrate the broad application potential of GRLV in existing MEG/EEG decoding models and the discovery of mental diseases. zh_abstract: [神经工程杂志] 深度学习模型已被广泛应用于利用脑磁图（MEG）信号预测重度抑郁症（MDD）。然而，这些模型往往性能有限、泛化能力不足。这主要是由于MEG时间信号固有的个体异质性很强，使得在小样本上训练的模型难以区分与疾病相关的特征和个体特异性特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GRLV，一种基于梯度反转层并结合方差损失的即插即用框架，可方便地嵌入现有的深度学习分类模型。该框架在梯度反转层（GRL）框架中引入方差损失函数，以弥补其收敛方面的局限。我们在10个骨干模型上评估了GRLV，平均分类准确率为68.2%，比基线模型高出3.5%。可视化结果证明，GRLV框架能够有效关注刺激呈现后最初100 ms内双侧枕叶的活动，这与MDD患者对负性情绪面孔的早期加工相关，并且由于受个体异质性的污染较少，是更好的疾病标志物。这些发现充分证明了GRLV在现有MEG/EEG解码模型中的广泛应用潜力，以及其在发现精神疾病方面的价值。这些发现充分证明了GRLV在现有MEG/EEG解码模型上的广泛适用性，及其在推进精神障碍生物标志物发现方面的潜力。

title: Transitions of Care in Clinical Oncology: Current Applications and Future Opportunities Enabled by Artificial Intelligence and Digital Health.

abstract: [JCO clinical cancer informatics] Transitions of care from hospital to outpatient settings represent a vulnerable period for patients with cancer, who often face complex treatment regimens, multiple comorbidities, and fragmented coordination across care settings. These challenges contribute to communication breakdowns and unplanned hospital readmissions. Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies offer new opportunities to improve the transitional phases before, during, and after hospital discharge, and strengthen care continuity. This review examines emerging approaches enabled by AI and digital health across the inpatient-to-outpatient care spectrum for hospitalized patients with cancer. We discuss how predictive analytics and clinical decision support can identify patients at elevated risk of complications and guide discharge planning before hospitalization ends. We also review existing AI and digital health solutions tailored to the discharge process, including tools that enhance patient and caregiver education, medication reconciliation, follow-up coordination, discharge documentation, and management of pending test results. Finally, we explore post-discharge technologies, such as remote monitoring, symptom tracking systems, and AI-assisted communication platforms, that empower earlier detection of clinical deterioration and facilitate integration with outpatient and community-based resources. Overall, we highlight, as well as describe the limitations of, innovations that seek to improve coordination, reduce administrative burden, and support safer, more proactive transitions of care for patients undergoing cancer treatment.
zh_abstract: [JCO clinical cancer informatics] 从医院到门诊环境的照护过渡，对癌症患者而言是一个脆弱时期，他们常面临复杂的治疗方案、多种合并症以及跨照护场所的碎片化协调。这些挑战会导致沟通中断和非计划再入院。人工智能（AI）和数字健康技术的进步为改善出院前、出院期间及出院后的过渡阶段并加强照护连续性提供了新机遇。本综述探讨了 AI 和数字健康在住院癌症患者从住院到门诊全程照护中的新兴方法。我们讨论了预测分析和临床决策支持如何在住院结束前识别并发症风险升高的患者并指导出院计划。我们还回顾了针对出院流程的现有 AI 和数字健康解决方案，包括加强患者及照护者教育、药物重整、随访协调、出院文书以及待回报检查结果管理的工具。最后，我们探讨了出院后技术，如远程监测、症状追踪系统和 AI 辅助沟通平台，这些技术有助于更早发现临床恶化，并促进与门诊及社区资源的整合。总体而言，我们强调并描述了这些旨在改善协调、减轻行政负担、支持癌症治疗患者更安全、更主动照护过渡的创新及其局限性。

abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) regulate complex pathophysiological networks and represent a critical class of drug targets, but their structural determination and ligand screening are constrained by dependence on homology templates, static conformations, and a bias toward known ligands. Artificial intelligence is fundamentally transforming GPCR structural biology and pharmacology by overcoming these bottlenecks. The methodologies encompass high-precision static structure prediction, dynamic conformational ensemble modeling, ultra-large-scale virtual screening, de novo ligand design, allosteric mechanism decoding, biased signaling quantification, and systems pharmacology. Deep learning architectures enable end-to-end structure prediction exemplified by AlphaFold series, billion-compound virtual screening and unbiased de novo ligand design via diffusion models. Three-dimensional structure-aware Graph neural networks and molecular dynamics simulations are shifting research focus from single static conformations to transient conformations, cryptic allosteric sites, and ligand-induced biased signaling. Systems-level investigation through multi-omics-integrated GPCR digital twins advances personalized precision medicine. This review summarizes the innovative AI-driven paradigm, breaking traditional restrictions and greatly improving structural resolution of orphan receptors and GPCR complexes, thereby offering a comprehensive reference for dynamic GPCR pharmacological research. Core challenges include the black-box nature of deep learning, structural distribution biases, and the translational gap, which can be addressed by physics-informed models and high-throughput validation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）调控复杂的病理生理网络，是一类重要的药物靶点，但其结构解析和配体筛选受限于对同源模板的依赖、静态构象以及对已知配体的偏倚。人工智能正通过突破这些瓶颈，从根本上改变GPCR结构生物学和药理学。相关方法涵盖高精度静态结构预测、动态构象系综建模、超大规模虚拟筛选、从头配体设计、变构机制解析、偏向性信号定量以及系统药理学。深度学习架构使端到端结构预测成为可能（以AlphaFold系列为代表），并可通过扩散模型实现十亿级化合物的虚拟筛选和无偏倚的从头配体设计。具有三维结构感知能力的图神经网络和分子动力学模拟正使研究重点从单一静态构象转向瞬时构象、隐蔽变构位点以及配体诱导的偏向性信号。通过整合多组学的GPCR数字孪生开展系统层面的研究，推动了个体化精准医学的发展。本综述总结了这一由人工智能驱动的创新范式，其打破了传统限制，大幅提高了孤儿受体和GPCR复合物的结构解析度，从而为动态GPCR药理学研究提供了全面参考。核心挑战包括深度学习的黑箱性质、结构分布偏倚以及转化鸿沟，这些问题可通过物理信息模型和高通量验证加以解决。

abstract: Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. On 40 held-out children, agreement with clinicians was modest, with quadratic weighted kappa between 0.22 and 0.30. Replacing every example's label with a wrong one changed about a third of the few-shot predictions, more often towards the corrupted labels than chance, but did not lower agreement, 0.25 with correct and 0.23 with wrong labels. A larger second model did the same. The anchored comparison did not improve on few-shot scoring, its cross-child judgements were no more accurate than those implied by absolute scores, and routing did not help. Among the registered, uncalibrated arms, direct scoring of the full transcript agreed best at 0.30. Exploratory follow-up analyses found that the model's graded judgements ranked children better than its final scores, that existing batch calibration raised agreement to 0.46 on the same children, and that in controlled synthetic sessions scoring episodes separately did not beat calibrated whole-transcript scoring. Expert-scored examples do not by themselves calibrate model-based clinical raters, and claims of calibration or added pipeline complexity need corrupted-label controls and strong baselines.

title: GASTON-VI efficiently quantifies spatial axes and molecular gradients from multi-sample, multi-modal spatial-omics data

summary: 提出基于变分推断的深度学习方法GASTON-VI，用于在多样本、多模态空间组学数据中识别空间轴和分子梯度（预印本）。
key_points: 现有方法局限于单切片小规模数据

abstract: Many tissues exhibit an underlying spatial axis along which fundamental biological processes occur due to continuous spatial gradients of cell type and molecular state. Modern spatial-omics technologies measure molecular features (e.g. gene/protein expression) at 100,000s-1,000,000s of locations within a two-dimensional (2-D) tissue slice, with large-scale atlases profiling multiple tissue slices of the same organ type across different individuals and biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). However, existing computational methods for identifying spatial molecular gradients are limited to small spatial transcriptomics datasets (1000s of cells) of a single tissue slice, while methods for integrating multiple samples do not explicitly model spatial axes nor spatial molecular gradients along such axes. Here, we present GASTON-VI, a variational inference (VI)-based deep learning model which efficiently learns an underlying spatial axis and spatial molecular gradients along this axis from multi-sample, multi-condition spatial-omics data of any molecular modality (e.g. transcriptomics, proteomics). GASTON-VI jointly learns (1) a spatial coordinate (the "isodepth") for each individual tissue slice and (2) 1-D spatial modality functions that describe molecular gradients along the isodepth for tissues of the same biological condition, while utilizing a latent variable model to account for batch effects. Further, GASTON-VI implements a statistical test for identifying molecules with differential spatial gradients across biological conditions (e.g. healthy versus diseased). On spatial transcriptomics and proteomics data from the intestine, tonsil, and liver, we show that GASTON-VI recovers spatial axes and molecular gradients along these axes more accurately and efficiently than existing methods. In particular, applied to large-scale spatial transcriptomics and proteomics atlases, GASTON-VI reveals differential spatial gradients of gene expression along the portal vein-central vein axis in fibrotic livers, and differential spatial gradients of protein abundance along the muscularis-lumen axis across different regions of the intestine. Software availability: GASTON-VI is available at https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI.
zh_abstract: 许多组织呈现出一条潜在的空间轴，由于细胞类型和分子状态的连续空间梯度，基本生物学过程沿该轴发生。现代空间组学技术可在二维（2-D）组织切片内数十万至上百万个位置测量分子特征（如基因/蛋白表达），大规模图谱则对不同个体和不同生物学条件（如健康与疾病）下同一器官类型的多个组织切片进行分析。然而，现有用于识别空间分子梯度的计算方法仅限于单个组织切片的小型空间转录组数据集（数千个细胞），而整合多个样本的方法既未显式建模空间轴，也未对沿该轴的空间分子梯度进行建模。在此，我们提出 GASTON-VI，这是一种基于变分推断（VI）的深度学习模型，可从任意分子模态（如转录组、蛋白质组）的多样本、多条件空间组学数据中高效学习潜在的空间轴及沿该轴的空间分子梯度。GASTON-VI 联合学习：（1）每个组织切片的空间坐标（“isodepth”）；（2）描述同一生物学条件下组织中沿 isodepth 的分子梯度的一维空间模态函数，同时利用潜变量模型处理批次效应。此外，GASTON-VI 实现了一种统计检验，用于识别在不同生物学条件（如健康与疾病）之间具有差异空间梯度的分子。在来自肠、扁桃体和肝脏的空间转录组和蛋白质组数据上，我们显示 GASTON-VI 比现有方法更准确、更高效地恢复空间轴及沿这些轴的分子梯度。具体而言，应用于大规模空间转录组和蛋白质组图谱时，GASTON-VI 揭示了纤维化肝脏中沿门静脉-中央静脉轴的基因表达差异空间梯度，以及肠道不同区域沿肌层-管腔轴的蛋白丰度差异空间梯度。软件可用性：GASTON-VI 可在 https://github.com/chitra-lab/GASTON-VI 获取。

title: XenoType: Decoding cellular identity in breast cancer histology through molecular supervision
zh_title: XenoType：以分子监督从乳腺癌H&E识别细胞身份
summary: 预印本提出XenoType框架，利用同切片配对的空间分子数据监督，直接从常规H&E图像将细胞分为七类分子信息类别。
key_points: 直接从常规H&E组织学图像分类细胞

abstract: Characterizing the cellular composition of the tumor microenvironment from histological images is fundamental to understanding cancer biology and informing treatment decisions. Deep learning has enabled automated nuclear detection and classification from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images, yet cell classifiers remain largely confined to broad morphological categories owing to a reliance on manual annotations. Recent efforts have used spatial molecular measurements to supervise histological classification, but these approaches often require separate tissue sections or produce altered H&E staining, and the resulting cell-type annotations depend on subjective choices such as marker selection and clustering parameters. Here we develop XenoType, a framework that classifies cells into seven molecularly informed categories directly from routine histology, trained using paired same-section Xenium spatial transcriptomics. Cell-type annotations are reconciled from four single-cell RNA-sequencing references, reducing dependence on marker choices. Across eight held-out breast tissue sections, XenoType outperformed commonly used CellViT++ retrained on the same molecular annotations under both four-class (macro-F1: 0.703 vs. 0.569) and seven-class (macro-F1: 0.571 vs. 0.403) taxonomies, with the largest gains for myoepithelial (F1: 0.175 to 0.572) and endothelial cells (F1: 0.395 to 0.682). Molecular measurements are required only during training; at inference, XenoType uses the H&E image alone. Model-reference agreement increased consistently with annotation confidence, and XenoType generalized to an independently profiled breast tissue section from a different spatial transcriptomics platform, supporting scalable cell-type mapping from routine histology without per-specimen molecular profiling.
zh_abstract: 从组织学图像表征肿瘤微环境的细胞组成，对于理解癌症生物学和指导治疗决策至关重要。深度学习已能从苏木精-伊红（H&E）图像中自动检测和分类细胞核，但由于依赖人工标注，细胞分类器在很大程度上仍局限于较宽泛的形态学类别。近期有研究利用空间分子测量来监督组织学分类，但这些方法通常需要单独的组织切片，或会导致H&E染色改变，且由此得到的细胞类型注释取决于标志物选择和聚类参数等主观选择。在此，我们开发了XenoType，这是一个可直接从常规组织学图像将细胞分为七个分子信息类别的框架，使用同一切片配对的Xenium空间转录组学进行训练。细胞类型注释由四个单细胞RNA测序参考数据整合而成，从而降低了对标志物选择的依赖。在八张留出的乳腺组织切片上，XenoType在四分类（macro-F1：0.703 vs. 0.569）和七分类（macro-F1：0.571 vs. 0.403）体系下均优于在相同分子注释上重新训练的常用模型CellViT++，其中肌上皮细胞（F1：0.175提高至0.572）和内皮细胞（F1：0.395提高至0.682）的提升最大。分子测量仅在训练时需要；在推理时，XenoType仅使用H&E图像。模型与参考注释的一致性随注释置信度的提高而持续增加，并且XenoType可泛化至来自不同空间转录组学平台、独立检测的乳腺组织切片，支持无需逐例标本分子检测的、可扩展的常规组织学细胞类型图谱绘制。

title: VenusPheno: Transfer-Guided Task Grouping for Multi-Task Bacterial Phenotype Prediction
zh_title: VenusPheno：基于迁移引导任务分组的细菌表型多任务预测
summary: 预印本提出VenusPheno，结合ProtT5蛋白嵌入的多实例学习与迁移引导多任务学习，在12,178个细菌基因组的14个表型任务上评估。
key_points: Set Transformer聚合基因组内蛋白嵌入

abstract: Understanding how genomic information gives rise to bacterial phenotypes is a fundamental problem in biology. Genome-level prediction requires models that integrate information from thousands of proteins, while related phenotypes may share genomic signals. However, not all phenotype tasks benefit from being learned together, and suitable task groups can be difficult to define from biological knowledge alone. We present VenusPheno, a framework that combines multiple-instance learning over pretrained ProtT5 protein embeddings with transfer-guided multi-task learning. An attention-based Set Transformer aggregates the proteins in each genome into a genome-level representation. We evaluate VenusPheno on 14 binary phenotype tasks from 12,178 bacterial genomes using genus-disjoint splits. Under single-task training, VenusPheno outperforms computational, conventional machine-learning, and deep-learning baselines in terms of mean balanced accuracy. We then use leave-one-task-out analysis to estimate directed transfer relationship between phenotypes, revealing both beneficial and detrimental interactions. Grouping tasks based on these transfer relationships further improves mean balanced accuracy over independent training and joint training of all tasks. Although inferred without biological priors, the resulting groups are consistent with biologically plausible relationships among phenotypes. VenusPheno therefore combines accurate phenotype prediction with a data-driven strategy for determining which tasks should be learned together. The PyTorch implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/YJinling/VenusPheno.
zh_abstract: 理解基因组信息如何产生细菌表型是生物学中的一个基本问题。基因组水平的预测需要整合来自数千个蛋白质信息的模型，而相关表型可能共享基因组信号。然而，并非所有表型任务都能从联合学习中获益，仅凭生物学知识也难以界定合适的任务分组。我们提出 VenusPheno，该框架将基于预训练 ProtT5 蛋白质嵌入的多实例学习与迁移引导的多任务学习相结合。基于注意力的 Set Transformer 将每个基因组中的蛋白质聚合为基因组水平表示。我们在来自 12,178 个细菌基因组的 14 个二分类表型任务上，采用属不相交的数据划分评估 VenusPheno。在单任务训练下，VenusPheno 在平均平衡准确率方面优于计算方法、传统机器学习和深度学习基线。随后，我们采用留一任务法分析来估计表型之间的有向迁移关系，揭示了有益和有害的相互作用。基于这些迁移关系对任务进行分组，相较于独立训练和所有任务联合训练，进一步提高了平均平衡准确率。尽管推断过程未使用生物学先验，所得分组与表型之间生物学上合理的关系相一致。因此，VenusPheno 将准确的表型预测与一种数据驱动的、用于确定哪些任务应一起学习的策略相结合。PyTorch 实现已公开，网址为 https://github.com/YJinling/VenusPheno。

title: Data drift in clinical imaging AI: Medicolegal liability after deployment.
zh_title: 临床影像AI的数据漂移：部署后的医疗法律责任
summary: 文章讨论部署后数据分布变化导致AI性能下降时的医疗法律责任问题，包括监测义务、违约证明与因果认定。
key_points: 数据漂移无需代码错误即可降低模型性能

abstract: [Clinical imaging] Data drift refers to changes in the distribution or characteristics of input data after deployment that may adversely affect the performance of artificial intelligence (AI) systems, even when the software continues to function exactly as designed. Patient demographics, disease prevalence, referral patterns, imaging protocols and technology continue to evolve after deployment, resulting in a divergence between the data distribution a model was trained on and the distribution it encounters in practice, without any discrete coding error or malfunction. These technical realities raise distinctive medicolegal questions when a patient is harmed by a degraded model. Establishing negligence centers on whether an ongoing institutional duty exists to monitor for performance deterioration, how breach can be proved absent consensus benchmarks for surveillance frequency and how causation can be demonstrated where AI output is only one element of clinical decision-making and its reasoning may be an opaque "black box" to its users. Comparative fault principles may allocate responsibility according to relative control and knowledge among institutions, vendors and radiologists. Products liability exposure and federal preemption laws also play a role. Risk reduction measures include lifecycle documentation, risk proportionate surveillance, auditability of algorithms and outputs, contractual allocation of monitoring responsibility, and sustained clinician oversight. Radiologists and institutions should anticipate a standard of care that evolves well before controlling case law develops.
zh_abstract: [Clinical imaging] 数据漂移是指部署后输入数据的分布或特征发生变化，即使软件仍完全按设计运行，也可能对人工智能（AI）系统的性能产生不利影响。患者人口学特征、疾病患病率、转诊模式、影像检查方案和技术在部署后持续演变，导致模型训练所用的数据分布与其在实际中遇到的分布之间出现偏离，而这并不涉及任何明确的编码错误或故障。当患者因性能下降的模型而受到伤害时，这些技术现实引发了独特的医疗法律问题。认定过失的核心在于：是否存在持续监测性能退化的机构义务；在缺乏关于监测频率的共识基准的情况下如何证明违反该义务；以及当 AI 输出只是临床决策的一个环节、且其推理对使用者而言可能是不透明的“黑箱”时，如何证明因果关系。比较过错原则可依据机构、供应商和放射科医师之间相对的控制力和知情程度来分配责任。产品责任风险和联邦优先适用法律也发挥作用。降低风险的措施包括全生命周期文档记录、与风险相称的监测、算法及输出的可审计性、监测责任的合同分配，以及持续的临床医师监督。放射科医师和相关机构应预见到，注意标准的演变将远早于具有控制力的判例法形成之前。

title: Clinical decision support for precision dentistry: Trends and emerging prospects.

abstract: [Journal of the American Dental Association (1939)] Precision oral health requires clinicians to consider patient-specific clinical, biological, behavioral, imaging, and preference sensitive data when making clinical decisions. In routine oral health care, however, these data are often fragmented across electronic dental records, imaging platforms, diagnostic tests, narrative notes, and patient-generated sources. Clinical decision support (CDS) systems provide a mechanism for organizing these data and translating them into timely, evidence-informed recommendations at the point of care. A narrative review was conducted of peer-reviewed literature relevant to precision dentistry, CDS, dental informatics, artificial intelligence, biomarkers and omics technologies, and patient-generated health data. Priority was given to dental studies, which were supplemented by broader medical CDS literature when dental-specific evidence was limited. CDS systems can function as digital infrastructure and generate clinical recommendations based on patient-specific data using evidence-based knowledge and predictive analytics. In dentistry, CDS applications range from rule-based reminders and electronic quality measures to artificial intelligence-assisted radiographic interpretation, risk prediction, biomarker screening, and emerging multimodal platforms. The clinical readiness of these technologies varies substantially, and their value depends on data quality, validation, work flow integration, usability, interoperability, privacy safeguards, and clinician oversight. CDS systems can assist clinicians by offering evidence-based, personalized recommendations that synthesize pertinent and available information. These systems are crucial for practicing precision dentistry. Although efforts to enhance the adoption, usability, effectiveness, and acceptance of CDS systems continue, clinicians should always regard CDS systems as tools and retain full responsibility for their decisions and involve patients in the decision-making process.
zh_abstract: [美国牙科协会杂志（1939）] 精准口腔健康要求临床医生在做出临床决策时考虑患者特异性的临床、生物学、行为、影像及偏好相关数据。然而在常规口腔保健中，这些数据往往分散于电子牙科病历、影像平台、诊断检测、叙述性记录和患者自产生来源之中。临床决策支持（CDS）系统提供了一种机制，可组织这些数据并在诊疗现场将其转化为及时的、基于证据的建议。本研究对与精准牙科学、CDS、牙科信息学、人工智能、生物标志物与组学技术以及患者自产生健康数据相关的同行评议文献进行了叙述性综述。优先纳入牙科研究；在牙科特异性证据有限时，以更广泛的医学CDS文献作为补充。CDS系统可作为数字基础设施，利用循证知识和预测分析，基于患者特异性数据生成临床建议。在牙科领域，CDS应用范围涵盖基于规则的提醒和电子质量指标，直至AI辅助的影像判读、风险预测、生物标志物筛查及新兴的多模态平台。这些技术的临床成熟度差异很大，其价值取决于数据质量、验证、工作流程整合、可用性、互操作性、隐私保护以及临床医生的监督。CDS系统可通过提供综合相关可得信息的、基于证据的个体化建议来辅助临床医生。这些系统对于实践精准牙科学至关重要。尽管提升CDS系统的采纳度、可用性、有效性和接受度的努力仍在继续，临床医生仍应始终将CDS系统视为工具，对自己的决策承担全部责任，并让患者参与决策过程。

abstract: [Canadian family physician Medecin de famille canadien] To provide family physicians with a practical overview of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in primary care practice and their potential to address burnout, improve workflow, support clinical decision making, and enhance patient care. A comprehensive narrative review of AI tools in primary care was conducted using peer-reviewed literature from PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar, with subject headings artificial intelligence and primary care, along with related terms. Relevant real-world pilot projects and case studies were hand-searched to identify those not captured through database searches. Canadian family physicians are facing rising levels of burnout, driven by overwhelming administrative demands and increasing patient complexity. With 1 in 4 Ontarians estimated to be without a family doctor in 2026, primary care is under considerable strain. AI tools-particularly those powered by natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs)-offer timely, practical solutions across 4 domains: ambient AI scribes to reduce documentation time and enhance patient-physician interaction; intelligent document processing and clinical summarization to streamline inbox management and information retrieval; clinical evidence synthesis LLMs to summarize medical evidence at the point of care; and AI clinical decision support systems to improve diagnosis and disease management. Real-world implementation in primary care demonstrates these tools can improve workflow efficiency, reduce time spent on paperwork, enhance adherence to clinical guidelines, and improve patient satisfaction. However, inaccuracies in AI-generated content, model bias, lack of transparency, and data privacy risks all require careful oversight. AI and NLP applications have potential to be timely tools that reduce strain and restore capacity for relational, person-centred care. Thoughtful adoption-guided by evidence-informed deployment, user-centred design, and regulatory safeguards-will be essential to ensure safe, equitable integration into primary care practice.
zh_abstract: [加拿大家庭医师 Medecin de famille canadien] 旨在为家庭医师提供人工智能（AI）在基层医疗实践中的应用及其在缓解职业倦怠、改善工作流程、支持临床决策和提升患者照护方面潜力的实用概述。本研究对基层医疗中的AI工具进行了全面的叙述性综述，文献来自PubMed、IEEE Xplore和Google Scholar的同行评议文献，检索主题词为人工智能和基层医疗及相关术语。另通过手工检索，纳入数据库检索未涵盖的相关真实世界试点项目和案例研究。加拿大家庭医师的职业倦怠水平不断上升，原因在于繁重的行政事务需求和患者复杂性的增加。据估计，2026年安大略省每4人中就有1人没有家庭医生，基层医疗面临相当大的压力。AI工具——尤其是由自然语言处理（NLP）和大语言模型（LLM）驱动的工具——可在4个领域提供及时、实用的解决方案：用于减少文书记录时间并增进医患互动的环境式AI书记员；用于简化收件箱管理和信息检索的智能文档处理与临床摘要；用于在诊疗现场总结医学证据的临床证据综合LLM；以及用于改善诊断和疾病管理的AI临床决策支持系统。基层医疗中的真实世界应用表明，这些工具可提高工作流程效率、减少文书工作时间、增强对临床指南的依从性并提高患者满意度。然而，AI生成内容的不准确性、模型偏倚、缺乏透明度以及数据隐私风险均需审慎监管。AI和NLP应用有望成为及时的工具，减轻压力并恢复开展注重关系的、以人为本的照护的能力。以循证部署、以用户为中心的设计和监管保障为指导的审慎采纳，对于确保其安全、公平地融入基层医疗实践至关重要。

abstract: [Current topics in medicinal chemistry] Forty to fifty percent of patients have at least one copy of the APOE4 gene mutation, which is the major genetic risk factor for late-onset alzheimer's disease. Risk is increased three to seven times by carrying one copy (heterozygous) and up to twelve to fifteen times by carrying two copies (homozygous). This cognitive decline is linked to impairments in perception, vocabulary, social interaction, and visuospatial performance, as well as alterations in executive function, which affect the capacity to carry out daily tasks. The purpose of this study is to provide comprehensive information on the diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease. Various search engines like Pub Med, Scopus, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and Elsevier databasesare searched. Progressive loss of memory is the most common symptom of the disease. Advanced medical imaging technologies offer important insights into human anatomy and function. Compounds with mechanisms of action and clinical trials are also incorporated. This also compiles literature on nanocarriers for improved bioavailability. Altogether, 194 studies are included. Amyloid-β plaques are pathologically seeded within the nervous system by APOE, with APOE4 promoting earlier and more prevalent amyloid deposition. Furthermore, by identifying alterations in the brain, Convolutional Neural Networks, a type of deep learning and machine learning technology, have shown an elevated level of precision in diagnosing AD. The Present manuscript has promising therapeutic outcomes, integrating extensive evidence on phytocompounds, nanoparticle-based approaches, and clinical trials. It also highlights key diagnostic parameters and emphasizes the potential of these therapeutic strategies to improve treatment efficacy while minimizing systemic adverse effects.

abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] Accurate identification of near-fall events is essential for early fall-risk assessment and prevention in older adults. However, translating laboratory-trained machine learning algorithms into real-world settings remains challenging because abnormal gait patterns do not necessarily represent genuine near-fall events. This correspondence highlights the distinction between sensor-detected gait perturbations and clinically meaningful losses of balance, emphasizing the limitations of conventional signal-based classification and the absence of event-level validation. We propose a context-grounded multimodal framework integrating wearable sensor data with large language model-derived information from patient narratives, caregiver reports, and clinical documentation. Such integration could support contextual event interpretation, distinguish habitual gait instability from transient balance disturbances, and facilitate clinically adjudicated near-fall identification. We further emphasize the importance of prospective validation, uncertainty-aware prediction, subgroup fairness, and clinically relevant performance metrics. Advancing from isolated movement classification toward context-aware, clinically validated event detection may improve individualized fall-risk prediction and support more effective preventive interventions in geriatric care.

title: Artificial intelligence in influenza prevention and control: translational pathways, supporting evidence, and system-level challenges.

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to influenza prevention and control. AI encompasses conventional machine learning, deep learning, and protein language models. Large language models (LLMs) are an emerging subset of AI. Current evidence remains weakly linked to real-world workflows and population health outcomes. This structured narrative review proposes a three-stage translational maturity framework. Phase I is technical efficacy assessment. Phase II is implementation effectiveness verification. Phase III is population impact and sustainability. We synthesized evidence in three domains: viral evolution prediction and vaccine design; epidemic surveillance and early warning; and individual-level infection risk detection and clinical monitoring. We used a three-level evidence hierarchy. Level A is influenza-specific evidence. Level B is transferable evidence from other infectious diseases. Level C is general biomedical or methodological evidence. Only two Phase II studies were identified, both in epidemic surveillance and early warning; no Phase II studies were identified in virus evolution and vaccine design or in individual-level infection risk detection. No study met the prespecified Phase III criteria. Phase III requires demonstrated downstream population health benefit. Prospective deployment or improved forecasting alone is not sufficient. Across domains, bottlenecks have shifted from model accuracy to governance, interpretability, accountability, interoperability, workflow integration, equity, and sustainable monitoring. LLMs attract major attention, but their influenza-specific evidence remains limited. Their greatest value may lie in augmenting, not replacing, specialized models and human expertise. We propose phase-specific evidence thresholds, implementation-oriented evaluation metrics, an implementation readiness checklist, and priority evidence gaps for translating AI-enabled influenza tools into implementation-ready public health applications.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能（AI）在流感防控中的应用日益增多。AI 包括传统机器学习、深度学习和蛋白质语言模型。大语言模型（LLM）是 AI 中新兴的一个子集。目前的证据与真实世界工作流程及人群健康结局之间的联系仍然较弱。本结构化叙述性综述提出了一个三阶段转化成熟度框架：第一阶段为技术效能评估；第二阶段为实施有效性验证；第三阶段为人群影响与可持续性。我们在三个领域综合了证据：病毒进化预测与疫苗设计；疫情监测与早期预警；以及个体层面的感染风险检测与临床监测。我们采用三级证据层次：A 级为流感特异性证据；B 级为来自其他传染病的可迁移证据；C 级为一般生物医学或方法学证据。仅发现两项第二阶段研究，均属于疫情监测与早期预警领域；在病毒进化与疫苗设计领域以及个体层面感染风险检测领域均未发现第二阶段研究。没有研究符合预先设定的第三阶段标准。第三阶段要求证明下游人群健康获益；仅有前瞻性部署或预测改进并不足够。在各领域中，瓶颈已从模型准确性转向治理、可解释性、问责、互操作性、工作流程整合、公平性以及可持续的监测。LLM 备受关注，但其流感特异性证据仍然有限。其最大价值可能在于增强而非取代专业模型和人类专业知识。我们提出了分阶段的证据阈值、面向实施的评价指标、实施就绪度核查清单以及优先证据缺口，以推动将基于 AI 的流感工具转化为可实施的公共卫生应用。

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] A growing consensus in the imaging community holds that radiomics has been rendered obsolete by foundation models and end-to-end deep learning. We disagree, and this perspective explains why. The critics are partially right: inter-operator segmentation variability has compromised reproducibility, methodological quality has been inconsistent, and the gap between published AUCs and clinical implementation has been wide. However, they draw the wrong conclusion. In renal cell carcinoma (RCC), where preoperative contrast-enhanced CT is already standard of care for every patient undergoing nephrectomy and where approximately 30% will recur after surgery, radiomics remain an immediately actionable, interpretable, and deployable non-invasive prognostic tool available. We argue that its primary technical limitation (segmentation variability) is being eliminated by the same deep learning technology used to argue against it: automated segmentation frameworks such as nnU-Net achieve Dice coefficients exceeding 0.93 on external cohorts, removing inter-operator noise. We further argue that in low-prevalence, high-stakes oncological settings, the data volumes required to pre-train foundation models do not exist, and that interpretability - now a regulatory requirement under the EU AI Act for high-risk clinical AI systems - is native to handcrafted radiomics and must be retrofitted onto deep learning architectures. Most critically, we present biological evidence that CT images encode tumor microenvironmental and molecular information invisible to the human eye. This generates a directly testable hypothesis: that preoperative radiomic scores can predict not only recurrence but also likelihood of benefit from adjuvant treatment. Radiomics is not dead. It is, at last, being done properly.

abstract: Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions (MLTCs), also known as multimorbidity, often present clinical and operational challenges in emergency departments (EDs), yet how their care pathways deviate from expected workflows remains underexplored. This study introduces a process-aware analytical framework that quantifies and interprets ED process deviations by integrating multi-perspective conformance checking with explainable machine learning. Using routinely collected Scottish ED data between 2017-2023, we derived an empirical benchmark pathway. We introduced a new metric, the deviation score (DS), which captures both structural misalignments and breaches of the four-hour ED standard, a national service target defined as completion of ED care within four hours of arrival. Compared with non-MLTC attendances, MLTC patients exhibited longer and more complex pathways, higher DS values, and lower conformance to the benchmark model. The framework enabled interpretable SHAP analyses, revealing that deviation severity among MLTC attendances was primarily associated with triage acuity, year of attendance, activity queue length (number of patients queuing for the same care activity), and referral source, with additional contributions from age, arrival time, and number of chronic conditions. Threshold effects were observed in both queue length and multimorbidity burden, beyond which deviation severity increased sharply, suggesting points where standard pathways become harder to maintain. These findings show that deviation severity for MLTC patients is shaped by clinical urgency and system-level pressures at presentation. However, the inherent complexity of MLTC patients may further increase vulnerability to deviation. The framework offers the potential foundation for process evaluation and targeted improvement in emergency care.

abstract: Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression at single-cell resolution, but imperfect segmentation often misassigns transcripts between neighboring cells, a problem known as transcript spillover. This spillover is niche-dependent and can therefore confound downstream analyses that rely on niche-specific differential expression. True spillover cannot be directly quantified in experimental ST data, so existing correction methods infer contamination indirectly from transcript positions or expression structure. Here we introduce SYNDRI, a post-segmentation correction method that frames spillover detection as a supervised, gene-level classification task. We develop SYNDRI-SIM to generate labeled training data by simulating spillover between spatially mapped scRNA-seq profiles. SYNDRI uses a transformer to predict gene-level spillover probabilities conditioned on each cell's expression, identity, and local neighborhood, without requiring transcript-level coordinates or deconvolution. On held-out simulated data, SYNDRI achieves an AUPRC of 0.86, compared with 0.64 for the next-best method. Across MERFISH, CosMx, and Xenium datasets, SYNDRI achieves the highest aggregate performance across metrics of cell-type separation, reference similarity, and preservation of within-cell-type heterogeneity. In a CosMx lung cancer dataset, SYNDRI removes nearly all potentially contaminating tumor and macrophage markers from differential expression between tumor-associated and stromal fibroblasts while retaining native fibroblast markers. These results demonstrate the utility of learning from simulated spillover to improve the interpretation of spatial gene expression.

abstract: [Journal of functional morphology and kinesiology] Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to physiological prediction, physical activity monitoring, and personalized exercise prescription. However, evidence regarding its practical effectiveness remains heterogeneous. This systematic review examined applications of AI, machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL) in exercise-related prediction, monitoring, and personalization among adults. Methods: Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, PubMed and Scopus were searched for studies published between 2015 and 2025, with Google Scholar used as a supplementary source. Eligibility followed PICO: adults aged 18 years or older (P); AI, ML, or DL applications for exercise prediction, monitoring, or personalization (I); conventional or non-personalized approaches, where applicable (C); and predictive accuracy and physiological, functional, or behavioral exercise outcomes (O). Findings were synthesized descriptively. Results: Ten studies were included: four examined physiological or energy-expenditure prediction, two investigated activity-related behavioral outcomes, two evaluated training-response classification or recommendation generation, and two assessed AI-personalized exercise interventions. Predictive models demonstrated promising performance in specific applications, although validation procedures and populations varied substantially. The intervention studies reported greater perceived exercise intensity and satisfaction in one trial and improvements in selected measures of balance, flexibility, and strength in another. Conclusions: AI-based approaches show potential for supporting exercise assessment, monitoring, and individualized decision-making. However, evidence regarding their superiority over conventional exercise prescription remains limited by the small number of intervention studies, methodological heterogeneity, and insufficient external validation. Further well-designed, long-term intervention studies are needed to establish their comparative effectiveness and practical benefits.

abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] Nasopharyngeal carcinoma is characterized by marked biological and clinical heterogeneity that is only partly captured by conventional anatomical staging. This narrative review examines how circulating biomarkers, radiomics, artificial intelligence (AI), molecular profiling, and functional tumor models may complement tumor-node-metastasis (TNM)-based risk stratification in nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). Relevant literature was identified through searches of PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar, primarily covering 2016-2026, with earlier landmark studies retained when relevant. Plasma Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) DNA is an established prognostic biomarker that complements anatomical staging, while longitudinal measurements provide information on treatment response and recurrence risk. Radiomics and AI offer additional possibilities for prognostic modeling, although their use in treatment selection remains investigational. abstract: [Journal of fungi (Basel, Switzerland)] The need for precise classification of fungi from microscopic images plays a critical role in diagnosing and treating patients since it requires timeliness and effectiveness. Nevertheless, manual examination is time-consuming and difficult due to the similar visual features of numerous fungi. Therefore, this work proposes a new approach to explainable deep learning for fungal image classification and report generation. The developed framework consists of four pre-trained convolutional neural network models-DenseNet121, ResNet18, VGG16, and InceptionV3-which are used to classify fungal microscopic images into five classes. To make the process more transparent, methods such as Grad-CAM, SHAP, LIME, and Canny edge detection are used to identify the areas of images that contribute to the prediction. At the same time, the developed approach uses the large language model LLaMA3-70B through LangChain and provides automatic generation of the structured diagnostic report, including fungal identification, confidence scores, and clinical observations. The whole pipeline is implemented using the Streamlit interface to predict and generate a PDF report of the classification. The experiments have been performed using publicly available data containing 5000 images of fungi with expert annotations. Among the models analyzed, DenseNet121 shows the highest result, reaching an accuracy of 99.75% and having the values of precision, recall, and F1-score close to 0.998.

abstract: [Journal of food allergy] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly penetrated health care and begun to influence clinical care, research, and health system operations. With food allergy, AI offers promise for clinical decision support, personalized care guidance, support of health literacy and a drive toward novel therapies. Despite growing enthusiasm, there are currently no U.S. Food and Drug Administration-cleared AI tools specifically indicated for food allergy, which underscores the need for a structured approach for evaluating, selecting, and implementing AI solutions within the domain. This narrative review focuses on a pragmatic framework for AI tool selection tailored to food allergy use cases. abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Venous thromboembolism (VTE) continues to pose a substantial health issue worldwide, characterized by high rates of mortality and morbidity. The field of artificial intelligence (AI) has shown potential as a valuable asset for enhancing the detection and prediction of complex diseases, such as VTE. This review explores the role of AI in VTE prediction and diagnosis, analyzing various machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches, including natural language processing (NLP), support vector machines (SVM), random forests (RF), logistic regression (LR), gradient boosting methods, and deep learning frameworks such as ClotCatcher. Among the artificial intelligence models, those based on natural language processing algorithms, particularly ClotCatcher, demonstrated strong performance in analyzing unstructured clinical data. ClotCatcher achieved exceptional Area under the Curve (AUC) values of 0.980 and 0.995 for venous thromboembolism (VTE) adjudication from radiology reports. AI-driven methodologies facilitate early detection, personalized risk assessment, and enhanced patient outcomes. AI holds great potential for improving VTE diagnosis and risk assessment, offering greater accuracy and efficiency than traditional methods. However, further studies are required to validate these models across diverse populations and clinical environments. The integration of AI in VTE management represents a promising frontier in personalized medicine, potentially leading to improved outcomes and more efficient healthcare delivery.

abstract: [Dentistry journal] Background/Objectives: The cross-sectional classification of mandibular growth-rotation morphology is relevant to orthodontic diagnosis and treatment planning, but conventional structural assessment is observer-dependent. This study developed and internally evaluated deep learning models for classifying existing clockwise and counterclockwise mandibular growth-rotation phenotypes on lateral cephalometric radiographs; it did not forecast future longitudinal growth. Methods: Eight hundred untreated radiographs from individuals aged 9-20 years were labelled by consensus using Björk and Skieller morphological indicators (clockwise, n = 376; counterclockwise, n = 424). A stratified 80:20 training-validation split was used. ResNet50, InceptionV3, and VGG16 were fine-tuned after Gaussian noise reduction, min-max normalisation, and limited geometric augmentation. Results: VGG16 showed the most favourable validation accuracy-loss profile. The archived aggregate confusion matrix (n = 800) yielded an apparent accuracy of 81.13% (95% CI, 78.38-83.75) and balanced accuracy of 81.32% (95% CI, 78.62-83.96); recall was 84.57% for clockwise and 78.07% for counterclockwise phenotypes. Because the matrix included the complete labelled cohort, these values are descriptive apparent performance and not an independent test estimate. Conclusions: VGG16 can classify cross-sectional mandibular growth-rotation phenotypes with promising apparent performance. External, longitudinal, and observer-benchmark validation is required before clinical use.

abstract: [Biosensors] Non-invasive salivary cortisol measurement requires separation of receptor binding from matrix effects and measurement artefacts. We combined a 1550 nanometre dual-graphene optical transducer with an antibody-functionalised cortisol assay and two separately evaluated artificial intelligence workflows. For structural modelling, 8192 scrambled Sobol proposals yielded 7941 accepted geometries. Grouped development selected an extremely randomised tree ensemble, whose sealed-test coefficient of determination was 0.986. Genetic and particle swarm searches were performed after model freeze, and direct transfer-matrix calculations gave a leading candidate sensitivity of 198.60 degrees per refractive-index unit and a resonance width of 0.1790 degrees. These computational candidates were distinct from the nominal cartridge used experimentally. The receptor-functionalised assay had a detection limit of 0.15 nanograms per millilitre and a validated quantitative range of 0.25-8.00 nanograms per millilitre. A gradient-boosted model using complete target and reference angular traces achieved mean absolute errors of 0.25 and 0.50 nanograms per millilitre in 25 blinded artificial-saliva samples and 40 human-saliva samples, respectively; conventional calibration gave corresponding errors of 0.34 and 0.62. Human-saliva measurements were compared with isotope-dilution liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Nominal 90% prediction intervals achieved 92% and 90% coverage. The nominal optical advantage over the simpler AZO/graphene reference was incremental, and residual cortisone cross-reactivity remained. These results support a proof-of-concept biosensor requiring further manufacturing and external clinical evaluation.
